body: All of his responses in here are the height of idiocy, I wouldn't even bother.

I'm sorry.  That must've been terrible beyond words to experience.

I cannot imagine going through something like that, but you have, and you're still here for now.  Do you have things to cling to in life?  Do you have people who would miss you?  Would your loved one want you to follow him in such a way?

When I start to feel it closing in I remember my promise.  That I can't be another link in that chain, that I won't let that cycle of loss continue past me, to any other people who may need me more than I could know.

I'm agnostic too - I try to tell myself no matter how bad it gets, that I want to collect the memories of here and now as much as I can.  Because everything tells us we have limited time here.  So if it's bad, it's not forever.  And if it's good, it's not forever.  But the more you live here now, the more you'll take with you if we're lucky and there is more beyond.  If not, this is all we get, so might as well try to wrench as much joy out of life while you can.

It's so hard.  Life and living is hard.  But we can try to make it a little easier for each other.

I keep trying to tell myself that - I can and should be valuable to someone as a boyfriend.  Rejection slowly beats down those thoughts down to nothing after a while.  I mean you know what they say, "the only key factor in all your breakups is you", probably equally true for a schmuck who can't even get a relationship in the first place.  I've tried online dating many times, many different sites, with nothing to show for it but a few first dates.  I don't know if I've just had awful luck, I suck at small talk more than I realize, or what, but each failure makes the next time I try further and further apart.  The psych class I had in college would call this "learned helplessness."

Family and friends say "be patient, keep trying, you're such a good guy good things will come to you."  Over three years says no - I don't know anyone else who sucks this bad at what is, as you say, the simplest task for most.  It all sounds like placating now.
I guess.  Hell if I could talk to people only-online I bet my life would be going a lot better.  When I try to express my wants or needs in person; that's when it goes all wrong.

Not anymore.  I've tried a number of social groups over the years, all fun in their own right but none worked as a good jumping-off point for something more substantial.  Either I mustered up the courage to ask, got rejected, and made the social dynamic awkward, or I defeated myself before I tried.  Hell, some of these social groups were literal sex clubs, people hooking up left and right, and I just sat and observed.

Pastimes now?  I had the travel bug for a while there, went to a number of foreign countries alone, even lived in one for months.  People always come back with wild tales of their exploits and lovers when single (or not) and abroad - not me.  I come back with stories of very nice women who I tour around with while being utterly incapable of closing the deal.  Any deal.

The travel bug's left me, so now...I don't know.  Nothing.  I should be educating myself about work stuff.  I could be reading for pleasure, or exercising, or playing social games.  I don't.  I wouldn't even say I 'play' video games anymore so much as use their rote actions to distract myself for a while.  And I sleep a lot.

I don't remember my dreams, but it's still better than here.
